31 October 2026. Universal mathematical classification for the fixed F.

THEOREM

Keep the acquired non-aligned quartic F. For EVERY nonzero real linear
form L on 2 by 2 matrices and EVERY homogeneous cubic C, the statements

 some finite nu makes F+C+nu L^2 globally rank-one convex;
 some finite nu makes F+C+nu L^2 globally quasiconvex

are equivalent. Their exact classification is as follows.

If C=0, every L works. If C is nonzero, L must, up to nonzero scalar,
proper output rotation and the retained Gamma symmetry, equal

                  L*(A)=a+z*(alpha b+d),                    (1)

where

 alpha=4748090704718821/13087217712479602193,

and z is the unique root in (-2/3,-33/50) of

 z^2-h z-k=0,
 h=157317852441155391852758584454957920824675853077288641117
    /184930581208580818616605897339555859064099754824564436900,
 k=171275267453839831574117303095530409249
    /171275289998205171811387535492202039290.                 (2)

Numerically, only for orientation, z is about -0.6613568437 and
alpha z is about -0.0002399427. The proof uses no root approximation.

For this exceptional square, the entire admitted cubic space has
dimension TWO. Its literal basis C1,C2 is in certificate.json. Each has
coefficient l1 norm at most one. They are genuinely outside the four
translation cubics. For every real t1,t2, a universal sufficient QC
completion is

 F+t1 C1+t2 C2+2^92 (|t1|+|t2|)^2 L*^2.                    (3)

This classifies FINITE STABILIZABILITY by EVERY nonnegative rank-one
quadratic direction, for the fixed leading F. It does not classify the
optimal nu, all quadratics of higher rank, or the full exposed ROC/QC
face. In particular QC of the separate 1859 fixture remains open.
The coefficient in (3) is a loose existence bound. The leading heat
certificate is reused and fully re-received. No historical priority,
external independent audit or general Morrey conclusion is asserted.
